items.title: Coinbase Fell 22% in a Month Before Its Charter Win: Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoinbase won final approval to run a national trust bank, joining Circle, and PNC launched a stablecoin payments pilot powered by Coinbase the same day. Third-quarter transaction revenue fell 44% to $590 million, while a $715 million crypto gain drove most of the $719 million net profit.
